claim: miR-335 plays a vital role in the development of depression, both in the brain and serum.
source: Previous psychiatric disease-related studies have mainly focused on miR-335. It plays a vital role in the development of depression, both in the brain and serum (Bocchio-Chiavetto et al., 2013; Fan et al., 2022; Li et al., 2015; Smalheiser et al., 2012).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous research.

claim: The downregulation of miR-335-3p under chronic psychological stress promotes FOS expression and osteoclast activity, leading to osteoporosis.
source: Our study further revealed the mechanism of miR-335-3p: it targets Fos so as to influence the activity of FOS-NFATC1 signaling pathway. As a result, the downregulation of miR-335-3p under chronic psychological stress promotes FOS expression and osteoclast activity, leading to osteoporosis.
evidence: This is a conclusion based on the study's experimental findings.
